shifted_multiplicative_correlations.authors: R. Balasubramanian, Sumit Giri, Priyamvad Srivastav
shifted_multiplicative_correlations.role: Classical antecedent for normalized shifted totient correlation. No novelty claim.

claims.theorem_A: For f(n)=phi(n)/n, fixed h, B_h=prod_(p|h)(1-2/p^2+1/p^3)*prod_(p not dividing h)(1-2/p^2), A=prod_p(1-2/p^2+1/p^3), V_h=2(A-B_h); sum_(n<=T)(f(n+h)-f(n))^2=V_h*T+O_h(log^2(2T)); classical shifted correlation. Every prime p not dividing h gives V_h>1/(9p^3).
claims.theorem_B: At the least Cook-admissible L, sum_(n=X+L+1)^(2X+L-1)[phi(n+h)-phi(n)]^2=(7/3)V_h*X^3+O_h(X^2 log^2(2X)).
claims.theorem_C: For ANY integer coefficient sequence with |a(n+h)-a(n)|<Q/2 at the endpoint interval, exact finite phase-energy inequality X-Re sum_N exp(2pi i D^a_(h,N,L)/Q)>=(8/(9Q^2))*sum_n[a(n+h)-a(n)]^2. Proof uses minimal congruence representative and finite (shift-2I) operator norm at most 3.
claims.theorem_D: For every fixed h, least L with Q=2^L>=16(2X+h+L+2), liminf_(X->infty)[X-Re sum_N E_(h,N,L)]/X >= 7 V_h/13824. Consequently for all sufficiently large X, Re sum_N E_(h,N,L) <= (1-V_h/2500)X, V_h/2500 > 1/(22500 p^3) for any prime p not dividing h. Does NOT establish Cook required 10% saving.
claims.method_ceiling: The exact particular L2 certificate (8/(9Q^2))*sum d_h^2 <= (1/288+o(1))*X for 0<=a(n)<=n and Cook depth. To guarantee X/10 from this particular certificate would require > (576/5) X^3 arithmetic squared energy, but envelope <= (4+o(1))X^3: >28.8-fold deficit. Not a bound on actual cancellation.
claims.rational_hostile: Previously source-locked affine-periodic 0..n rational-complete-series comparators have positive shifted squared energy and satisfy the same exact finite phase-energy inequality. Thus no irrationality promotion.
